groups.name: Single saturated accent color reused
groups.definition: Does the page use one single saturated accent color consistently for buttons, links, badges and similar key elements?

groups.name: Near-black text instead of pure black
groups.definition: Is body or heading text a tinted near-black, dark slate or charcoal rather than pure black?

groups.name: Alternating light section background bands
groups.definition: Do section backgrounds alternate between white and a pale tint or other colors to separate content bands?

groups.name: Muted tinted secondary text color
groups.definition: Is secondary text (dates, labels, footer copy) set in a muted gray, grey-blue or tinted color?

groups.name: Blue and navy dominant palette
groups.definition: Is the palette built primarily on blues and deep navy?

groups.name: Warm earthy or cream palette
groups.definition: Is the palette warm and earthy, with cream, off-white backgrounds and warm accent hues?

groups.name: Dark theme with layered dark surfaces
groups.definition: Does the page use a dark background with slightly lighter dark surfaces for cards and bands?

groups.name: Monochrome single-hue palette
groups.definition: Is the palette built on a single hue family (e.g. teal or green tones)?

groups.name: Status colors by metric threshold
groups.definition: Are metric values colored by threshold (green, orange, red)?
